lookback_summary: Well, folks, the model had a mixed bag this weekend! It correctly predicted the draw in the Fulham vs Man United match, so hats off there – didn't see that coming! The model also nailed the home wins for Man City and Newcastle, but I had to eat humble pie on some other calls, especially with Everton and Brighton both letting us down. Overall, it was a weekend of highs and lows, but there were some solid hits among the misses!
